sections.heading: ILS Law College vs Symbiosis Law School Pune for LLB: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose ILS Law College if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹11 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹37,300, in a private LLB setting at Pune.
Choose Symbiosis Law School Pune if you want a recorded NIRF 2024 #5, and a 2023 flagship package record of ₹8 LPA, in a private LLB setting at Pune.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

Our records show ₹37,300 as a tuition figure for Bachelor Of Legislative Law (LLB) at ILS Law College. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

Our records show ₹1.78 lakh as a tuition figure for LLB (Hons) at Symbiosis Law School Pune. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: ILS Law College's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹11 LPA and a highest package of ₹18 LPA on Bachelor Of Legislative Law (LLB). These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

Symbiosis Law School Pune's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹8 LPA and a highest package of ₹18 LPA on LLB (Hons). These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: ILS Law College is listed on our records with MH CET Law as an admission route for this LLB comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Symbiosis Law School Pune is listed on our records with MH CET Law as an admission route for this LLB comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Maharashtra. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether ILS Law College's recorded ₹37,300 or Symbiosis Law School Pune's ₹1.78 lakh fits your budget for this LLB.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, ILS Law College or Symbiosis Law School Pune?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. ILS Law College and Symbiosis Law School Pune differ in more than one way: Symbiosis Law School Pune has a recorded NIRF 2024 #5, and ILS Law College has no NIRF rank on this page.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for ILS Law College vs Symbiosis Law School Pune?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹37,300 for ILS Law College on Bachelor Of Legislative Law (LLB); our records list ₹1.78 lakh for Symbiosis Law School Pune on LLB (Hons). Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for ILS Law College and Symbiosis Law School Pune?
faqs.answer: ILS Law College's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹11 LPA and a highest package of ₹18 LPA on Bachelor Of Legislative Law (LLB). These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do ILS Law College and Symbiosis Law School Pune accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list MH CET Law for ILS Law College, and MH CET Law for Symbiosis Law School Pune. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are ILS Law College and Symbiosis Law School Pune in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Pune, Maharashtra. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
